median_rect — 2D rank op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "median_rect", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: median_rect (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

矩形メディアンフィルタ。`median_image と同じ scipy` 実装だが、

高さと幅を独立に指定できる(`size=(k_a, k_b))。HALCON の median_rect`

（Compute a median filter with rectangular masks.）に相当。

`a が窓の高さ、b が窓の幅を、それぞれ {3,5,7,9}(_k`)の 4 段階

で振る。両方が使われる。
